purpose: Fields a frozen RunEconomy experiment must fix before held-out execution. The planner fills each field from the manifest and design.planning; anything it cannot establish stays explicitly unknown.

claim.description: Claim level, primary metric, predicted direction, the single intervention variable, and references to the operator-authored hypothesis and claim boundary. Free text is referenced by field path and digest, never copied.

population.description: Experimental unit, pairing key, unique tasks, repetitions, planned pairs and attempts, the workload digest, and the held-out declaration.

gates.description: Every required gate with its rule and threshold: absolute task success for both variants, paired task-success non-inferiority, completion for both variants, and the latency criterion.

method.description: The preregistered task_success_method, its significance level, and its documented coverage properties.

n.description: Planned pairs, the power of every gate at that n under the declared assumptions, and the minimum pairs for the target power.

tolerance.description: The completion threshold as an exact integer tolerance per variant, the expected-failure model it came from, and the common-mode paired-failure policy.

cost_estimate.description: Estimated spend from declared per-attempt cost, compared with the declared ceiling.

stopping_rule.description: Fixed sample or a predeclared outcome-independent rule.
